requirement: Protocol section 17: a second independent validator must reproduce deterministic error codes, critical status, case status and aggregate counts.
decision: E1-G1, Renxi Qiu, 22 August 2026: YES, the independent-reimplementation requirement of protocol section 17 is removed for Experiment 1. The fixture and canonicalisation requirements of the same section remain in force and are met.
consequence: No second implementation was written and none will be. Every audit figure rests on a single implementation. Nothing here establishes that the results are independent of one implementer's reading of the contracts.
what_still_supports_the_numbers: validation/oracle_independence_report.json: the same code reproduces its own outputs byte for byte inside a clean room containing no oracle artefact
validation/fixture_report.json: 13 deterministic fixtures with pre-declared expected case status and expected error codes, 100 percent agreement

contracts/*.json and contracts/error_ontology.yaml: every check carries an identifier, a definition, a severity, a detection mode and a case-status effect, so a second implementer has a specification rather than a codebase to copy
